title: Child's pose

steps.text: Kneel on the mat with your knees a little apart and your big toes together.
steps.cue: Kneel, knees a little apart, big toes together.

steps.text: Sit your hips back toward your heels.
steps.cue: Sit your hips back toward your heels.

steps.text: Walk your hands forward and rest your forehead on the mat.
steps.cue: Walk your hands forward. Forehead down.

steps.text: Breathe slowly and let your shoulders relax.
steps.cue: Breathe slowly. Let your shoulders relax.

mistakes: Lifting the hips off the heels to reach further.
Pressing the forehead into the mat hard.
regression: Put a cushion between your hips and heels.
stopIf: Come out if your knees hurt.

anatomy.why: Folding forward with the hips back lets the muscles along the spine lengthen and rest.
